thm:main-finite-homogeneous-stationarity.title: Finite stationary classification and de Sitter convergence
thm:main-finite-homogeneous-stationarity.note: Proved. Euler equations: the partial derivatives (HasDerivAt) of S_d = -sum_{j<M}[A_0 (q_{j+1}-q_j)^2/s_j + B_0 s_j qbar_j^2] in s_j (j<M) and in the interior node q_j (1<=j<M, endpoints fixed) are exactly eq:main-discrete-lapse-constraint and eq:main-discrete-scale-euler. Classification: for A_0,B_0>0, omega = sqrt(B_0/A_0), every positive stationary path (both Euler expressions vanish) has one common sign sigma in {+-1} with q_{j+1} = q_j (1+sigma omega s_j/2)/(1-sigma omega s_j/2) and 0<omega s_j/2<1; converse proved; Lambda=0 forces constant q, Lambda<0 has no positive stationary path. Convergence: with tau_j = sum_{i<j} s_i, T = sum_{j<M} s_j, s_j <= h_t, 0 <= omega h_t/2 <= b < 1: |log(q_j/q_0) - sigma omega tau_j| <= omega^3 T h_t^2/(12(1-b^2)) for all j<=M, via 0 <= log((1+x)/(1-x)) - 2x <= 2x^3/(3(1-b^2)) on [0,b] (= 2 artanh x remainder, proved by derivative monotonicity), and the induced (2/3, 2, 4/3)-scaled logarithmic errors for a_j = q_j^{2/3} (drift sigma H_0, H_0 = 2 omega/3), rho_j = q_j^2, kappa_j = q_j^{-4/3}. Scoped: sequences on N with indices j<=M; 0 <= b added (automatic when M>=1); the identification with the continuum profiles of cor:main-derived-desitter-rates is the displayed exponential bound (no separate limit statement).

thm:main-operational-action-matching.title: Measured acceptance reconstructs the finite action
thm:main-operational-action-matching.note: Proved. eq:main-observed-cost: E_s(x,y) = -eps log(Z_s Q_s/p_s) for finite alphabets F (Finset R) with positive proposal weights, eps != 0. eq:main-offshell-action-match: for every path with q_{j+1} in the stage alphabet the observed writer equals the bulk action identically (C terms telescope, Finset.sum_range_sub); the first-variation clause is read as this pointwise off-shell identity on the whole parametric domain (no separate derivative statement). Mismatch box: y -> E_s(x,y) is minimised at y = r(s) x with r(s) = (A - Bs^2/4)/(A + Bs^2/4 + Cs) (scoped: A,B,s>0, Bs^2 < 4A, C^2 <= AB), log r(s)/s -> c = -C/A as s -> 0 (HasDerivAt at s = 0), the n-step skeleton with step tau/n converges to q_0 e^{c tau}; Lambda_act = 4B/(3A) is the B_0/2 of the A/A_0-rescaled discrete action (A_0 = 8/3), Lambda_geom = 4C^2/(3A^2) = 3H^2 with H = 2c/3 (q = a^{3/2}); using RelationalDeSitterBranch.einstein_cosmological_vacuum for the de Sitter metric with Hubble rate H: G + Lambda_act g = (4 D/(3A^2)) g as 4x4 matrices, and the residual vanishes iff D = AB - C^2 = 0.

thm:main-explicit-operational-family.title: Finite positive operational family with an Einstein limit
thm:main-explicit-operational-family.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: retry cap, M^-4, M^-6, proposal alphabet, piecewise-affine, H^1 convergence, stochastic profile.

thm:main-no-blocking-attractor.title: No transverse matching attraction under conservative blocking
thm:main-no-blocking-attractor.note: All displayed claims are proved: eq:main-hyperbolic-blocking (E_{mu,theta1,C} *_0 E_{mu,theta2,C} = E_{mu,theta1+theta2,C} as an exact inf over z>0, attained at the positive Schur minimizer; two-edge Schur identity lem:supp-two-edge-schur), invariance of mu^2=AB, C, D=AB-C^2 and Delta_rel under every finite sequence (List.foldl) of homogeneous blockings, the block map eq:main-homogeneous-block-map (A'=A+Bs^2/4, B'=AB/(A+Bs^2/4), C'=C) as the exact conservative block of two identical midpoint intervals under 0<s sqrt(B/A)<2, Delta_rel>0 preserved, invariance of C^2/(AB) under unit changes and common action rescaling, and the dictionary A/s +- Bs/4 = mu coth theta, mu csch theta with theta = 2 artanh((s/2)sqrt(B/A)). Scoped hypotheses: mu>0, theta_i>0, amplitudes x,y>0 (the paper's positive amplitude domain). NOT formalised: the closing sentence (finite positive amplitude alphabets with symmetric untwisted trial kernel: exact twist retention eq:supp-finite-twist-read and the low-temperature/grid limit eq:supp-finite-block-error); status kept open only for that sentence.

Its first half (twist retention: L_C = D_C L_0 D_C^{-1} with L_0 symmetric gives eps/(2(x^2-y^2)) log(L_C^n(x,y)/L_C^n(y,x)) = C) is an easy finite Matrix induction; the second half (grid/low-temperature Laplace bound eq:supp-finite-block-error and continuity of the three-probe reconstruction) is hard analysis.

prop:main-optimizer-composition.title: Optimizer composition characterizes action--law matching
prop:main-optimizer-composition.note: Proved in the paper's generality. hyperbolicCost is eq:main-hyperbolic-cost (coth = cosh/sinh, csch = 1/sinh). For μ > 0, |C| ≤ μ (i.e. |ρ| ≤ 1, ρ = C/μ) and θ > 0: hyperbolicCost_sub_optimizer gives E(x,y) - E(x, m_θ x) = (μ coth θ + C)(y - m_θ x)^2 with m_θ x = r_θ x, r_θ = (cosh θ + ρ sinh θ)^{-1}, hence optimizerMap_isMin / optimizerMap_unique (unique minimizer over all real y, in particular over y > 0) and optimizerMap_pos (m_θ x > 0 for x > 0): eq:main-optimizer-map. optimizerRatio_inv_add_sub is eq:main-optimizer-defect for all θ, φ, ρ. optimizerMap_comp_iff: for one positive pair (θ, φ) and one x > 0, m_{θ+φ} x = m_φ (m_θ x) iff Δ_rel = 0; relativeDefect_eq_zero_iff_comp packages both the every-positive-pair and the one-pair-at-one-x equivalences; relativeDefect_eq_zero_iff_mul_eq_sq identifies Δ_rel = 0 with AB = C^2 for μ = sqrt(AB), A, B > 0; optimizerRatio_of_relativeDefect_eq_zero gives ρ = ±1 and r_θ = exp(-ρ θ) on the matched branch. Scoped: the standing positivity |C| ≤ μ of the measured cost is a hypothesis; the local-Lipschitz stability remark of the appendix proof is not formalized (not part of the proposition).

thm:main-gowdy-regulator.title: Nonlinear two-polarization renewal regulator
thm:main-gowdy-regulator.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Gowdy, two-polarization, staggered momentum, Strang/source-transport splitting, cubic Hermite readout, areal gauge, Riem L^infty.

prop:main-safe-access.title: Finite proposal-access certificate
prop:main-safe-access.note: All displayed bounds are proved: eq:main-safe-proposal-bounds (mu e^{-c/eps} <= Z <= p(G) for the rule 1_G exp(-E/eps) with 0<=E<=c on G, eps>0, p(G)>=mu; D_KL(Q||p) >= -log p(G) for every probability row Q supported on G with Q<<p, in particular for the accepted row, using finiteKL from Action/FiniteGibbsActionGap), eq:main-safe-retry-bound on a measure space (independent reset attempts per stage, each failing with probability <= 1 - Z_j; Pr(some stage j<J fails) <= sum_j exp(-R_j Z_j) <= sum_j exp(-R_j mu_j e^{-c_j/eps_j})), the sufficient cap eq:supp-safe-retry-cap giving total failure <= delta, and the Borel-Cantelli clause (summable failure probabilities along a refinement => a.s. only finitely many refinements fail, no independence between refinements). def:supp-event-grammar.title: Finite typed event grammar
def:supp-event-grammar.note: FiniteTypedEventGrammar encodes (E1) Fintype CutType; (E2) Letter : CutType → CutType → Type with Fintype fibres; (E3) a Reachable predicate on typed words (TypedWord, snoc-built, with typed concatenation TypedWord.append and empty words TypedWord.nil) containing the empty words and prefix-closed (reachable_of_snoc); (E4) Fintype Preparation / InterventionOutcome / TerminalRead / Port alphabets; (E5) a distinguished terminal Read orientationRead with outcome set ≃ ℤˣ (the two values ±1) whose two values receive different verdicts under the declared readPolicy (orientation_separated). History x = Σ s, {h : TypedWord Letter s x // Reachable h} is H_{X,x}; Admissible h a is a ∈ Σ_{X,h}. ConditionalLaw (auxiliary, the conditional-probability clause of def:supp-operational-datum) carries p(a|h) ≥ 0, p(a|h) = 0 off Σ_{X,h}, and normalization over the admissible letters after every reachable history. Modelling choice disclosed: the Read policy is a verdict map on Read outcomes; no state label, metric, scheduler or spacetime datum is attached to histories, as the definition demands.

def:supp-future-signature.title: Complete predictive future signature
def:supp-future-signature.note: Typed encoding over FiniteTypedEventGrammar: wordProb is the chain law eq:supp-chain-law; futureSignature h = (p(w|h))_w indexed by the complete bank of typed future words starting at the cut type of h (eq:supp-future-signature); FutureEquivalent h h' for histories of the same cut type x (eq:supp-future-equivalence) is agreement of all future-word probabilities, and futureEquivalent_iff_futureSignature shows it is equality of signatures; futureSetoid x is ∼_X on H_{X,x}. Histories of different cut type live in different fibres and are never identified. futureEquivalent_snoc additionally proves thm:supp-right-congruence on the positive-probability branch. Scoped: the bank is all typed future words (non-admissible words have probability 0 by the law's off-admissible clause, so this is the admissible bank). The earlier fibrewise untyped encoding PredictiveSystem.FutureEquivalent / futureSetoid in Predictive/DerivedPredictiveCarrierUniversalExact.lean remains valid.

thm:supp-right-congruence.title: History-level right congruence
thm:supp-right-congruence.note: Future equivalence is an equivalence; equivalent histories have equal one-letter branch probabilities (eq:supp-one-letter-equality) and, whenever branch h a != 0 (the positive-probability branch), h a ~ h' a. Exactly the paper statement, fibrewise in cut type.

def:supp-predictive-state.title: Minimum predictive state
def:supp-predictive-state.note: Typed encoding: MinimalState x = Quotient (futureSetoid x) is Z^min_{X,x} = H_{X,x}/∼_X with the canonical surjection project = q_{X,x} (project_surjective); weight a = κ_{X,a}, with weight_project : κ_{X,a}([h]) = p(a|h) (well defined by the one-letter case); transition a z hz = T_{X,a} defined on the positive-probability branch 0 < κ_{X,a}(z) through a representative, and transition_project proves T_{X,a}([h]) = [h a] there, using the right congruence futureEquivalent_snoc. cor:supp-derived-state-machine.title: Derived predictive state machine

thm:supp-minimal-record.title: Canonical minimum predictive realization
thm:supp-minimal-record.note: For every reachable deterministic realization there is a unique map pi : State -> Z^min with pi o stateOf = q (toMinimal_unique), it is surjective, intertwines updates on occurring branches (pi(u_a s) = T_a(pi s) when rate s a != 0) and branch functions (kappa_a o pi = r_a); hence any ledger/hidden-state presentation has a unique quotient onto Z^min, and two ledger states are identified iff all their future laws agree. Fibrewise in cut type.

thm:supp-persistence-derived.title: Persistence derived from composition
thm:supp-persistence-derived.note: eq:supp-persistence is the instance minimalUpdate_mk_of_occurs with h = H_n and a = A_{n+1}: on any realized (positive-probability) branch [H_n A_{n+1}] = T_{A_{n+1}}([H_n]); the derived packet (Z_n, A_{n+1}, Z_{n+1}) is therefore a function of the event process, and every other deterministic persistent packet maps uniquely onto it by toMinimal_unique/surjective. Not stated as a separate named theorem in Lean; it is a direct instance of the cited results.

cor:supp-future-operational-transfer.title: Future-operational transfer
cor:supp-future-operational-transfer.note: For any state space with future-signature map sigma and any readout D constant on equal signatures, there is a unique Dbar on the minimal predictive quotient with D = Dbar o pi (exists-unique factorization), exactly eq:supp-compiler-factorization.

thm:supp-readable-relational-completion.title: Conservativity and future minimality of the readable packet
thm:supp-readable-relational-completion.note: (C1) the resolved Kraus-form branch has positive semidefinite Choi matrix (complete positivity) and the refined family is normalized by the same-history kernel (Kernel.normalized, a field/hypothesis as in the paper); (C2) forgetting the predictive block and marks intertwines every branch and every word (eq:supp-relational-forgetful) and the completion is a surjective process quotient; (C3)-(C4) future_minimality := MinimalRecordExact gives the unique coarsest all-future right congruence with the unique surjection from every future-sufficient presentation, and refinement rounds are bounded by the record count. Scoped: finite Z/Gamma/Xi, untyped records.

thm:supp-hankel.title: Canonical typed Hankel realization
thm:supp-hankel.note: For a typed table tbl : F -> P -> C with compatible past/future re-indexings, the transition A_a is a linear map sending the Hankel column of p to that of a o p, given by pullback of futures, and is unique on the span of the columns (eq:supp-hankel-transition/evaluation); for any other linear realization the reachable-modulo-unobservable quotient is isomorphic to the Hankel core, so dim N >= dim M with equality exactly for reachable future-separated realizations (hankel_minimality, hankel_minimality_finrank_eq). Typing is by arbitrary index types per cut/state.

thm:supp-comb-tomography.title: Finite process-comb tomography
thm:supp-comb-tomography.note: Positive trace-normalized physical probes separate Hermitian Choi tensors, so the tensor reconstructed from the frame probabilities is the unique Hermitian representative and is frame independent. The conditions R^{(0)} = 1, R^{(k)} >= 0 and the nested output-trace recursion (IsDeterministicCombThrough) construct canonical linked minimal-rank square-root factors (memories A_k = support of R^{(k)}) obeying the same causal recursion, and any two minimal purifications of a prefix differ by a unique memory unitary. Scoped: the converse "realization implies conditions" holds because FiniteDeterministicComb carries the conditions as a field, and the link isometries V_k are represented by the linked factors rather than as explicit maps H_{2k-2} (x) A_{k-1} -> H_{2k-1} (x) A_k.

lem:supp-contextual-ideal.title: Contextual nullity is a two-sided $*$-ideal
lem:supp-contextual-ideal.note: The set of elements invisible in every admitted context (u q v and u q* v annihilated by all Reads) is a two-sided star-closed ideal (hence the largest such ideal), the quotient map has exactly this kernel and is surjective, and contextual_envelope_universal proves the universal property: every context-preserving quotient factors uniquely through it and separated envelopes are injective images (minimum context-preserving separated envelope). Finite matrix-block model realized with a C*-algebra structure.

thm:supp-word-flatness.note: Partial: rank stabilization of the word/Krylov filtration at one depth forces stabilization forever and exhaustion of the generated algebra (flat_exhausts_generated_algebra_exact, krylov_stable_eq_minimal), a stable index exists in finite dimension (exists_stable_index), finite moment agreement through depth 2d-1 with Krylov minimality reconstructs the represented generator and source up to a unique unitary (finiteMoment_sourceFixingIntertwiner_existsUnique), and a word-basis isometry is a star-algebra isomorphism iff its monoidal innovation vanishes. thm:supp-calibration-fibre.title: Exact calibration fibre and minimum anchor bank
thm:supp-calibration-fibre.note: calibration_fibre_anchor_bank, for L : R^N -> R^M, b, a solution x0, and injective unit conventions U : R^d -> R^N with LU = 0: (K1) {x | Lx = b} = x0 + ker L and dim ker L = N - rank L; (K2) every injective linear anchor bank ker L -> R^k has k >= dim ker L and a bijective bank with exactly dim ker L anchors exists; (K3) dim (ker L / Im U) = N - rank L - d and the same necessary-and-sufficient anchor count on the quotient PhysicalResidual L U; (K4) for a six-root race with positive rates: the winner law k_b / sum k is invariant under common rescaling, the total rate is multiplied by the rescaling constant (so a nontrivial rescaling changes it), the exponential waiting time of total rate K has mean 1/K, and winner law times total rate recovers every rate. Scoped/disclosed: 'anchor bank' = linear map to R^k, 'determines one calibration' = injectivity; (K3) assumes U injective (d = rank U) as in the earlier partial file; (K4) is stated for the Fin 6 root alphabet.

ass:supp-relational-branch.title: Minimal faithful predictive relation branch
ass:supp-relational-branch.note: Single named object: MinimalFaithfulRelationBranch X A F extends FutureMinimalSerialCell (one source, one target, distinct; involutive reversal swapping endpoints; complete future signature whose equality is the future-minimal identification, minimal_identified_iff) by a symmetry subgroup of Perm X transitive on unordered pairs of distinct endpoints, a relation set of unordered endpoint pairs containing every letter's pair and invariant under the group, and nonemptiness of the letter alphabet. Consequences proved: the relation set has an off-diagonal pair, reversal keeps the unordered pair, and lem:supp-pair-completion (skeleton_complete: every unordered pair of distinct endpoints is a relation).

lem:supp-pair-completion.title: Pair-homogeneous completion
lem:supp-pair-completion.note: dimension_pairwise_completion proves that a relation set R of unordered pairs invariant under a permutation group transitive on off-diagonal pairs and containing one off-diagonal pair contains every off-diagonal pair, i.e. the colour-free skeleton is K_N; the exact version adds the +1/-1 oriented-edge incidence of each primitive relation and the future-minimal parallel-label alternative. thm:supp-cut-cycle.title: Cut--cycle decomposition
thm:supp-cut-cycle.note: Signed-edge (antisymmetric-matrix) rendering of Lambda^2 R^N with boundary = row sums: d(x∧y) = (Σy)x - (Σx)y, d(u0∧w) = -√N w for mean-zero w (opposite sign convention), Ran d = mean-zero subspace W_N, and the canonical orthogonal decomposition A = cutPart + cyclePart with d(cyclePart) = 0 and dA = 0 iff cutPart = 0 (Ker d = boundary-free currents = Lambda^2 W_N). thm:supp-k4-selector.title: Minimal faithful $K_4$ selector on the alternating simplex branch

lem:supp-root-frame.title: Root dyadics span $\Sym_3$

thm:supp-adm-frame.title: Complete finite ADM frame
thm:supp-adm-frame.note: adm_frame_complete bundles: (A1) the six root dyadics r_a r_a^T are a basis of Sym_3 (rate sums <-> B_h); (A2) the rate-difference map is onto R^3 with kernel exactly the span of the three tetrahedral face cycles, of dimension 3; existence: the boxed formula g = rho^{2/3}(det B)^{1/3} B^{-1}, N = rho^{1/3}(det B)^{1/6} satisfies sqrt(det g) = rho and N^2 g^{-1} = B; uniqueness (adm_inversion_unique, new): every N > 0, g with det g > 0 solving B = N^2 g^{-1}, rho = sqrt(det g) equals the boxed pair (determinants give N^6 = rho^2 det B, positivity fixes N, then g = N^2 B^{-1}). lem:supp-fast-clock.note: Clause (A5): if v·(h^2 Σ_a k_a r_a r_a^T v) ≥ c|v|^2 for all v then 3c ≤ 2h^2 Σ_a k_a, i.e. Σ_a k_a ≥ 3c/(2h^2), which is the paper's bound with R^2 = 2 = max ‖r_a‖^2 for the concrete A_3 roots (and hence implies the bound for every admissible R ≥ √2). lem:supp-positive-krein-distinct.title: Positive geometry and Krein signature are distinct layers
lem:supp-positive-krein-distinct.note: positive_krein_distinct_layers: for a positive functional tau (tau(a* a) >= 0 in real part) on a complex *-algebra, the word Gram K(v,w) = tau(v* w) of any word family with the orientation record theta adjoined (index type iota + Unit) is positive semidefinite and its old block is unchanged (wordGram_adjoin_positive, via sum conj(c_v) c_w K(v,w) = tau(a* a)); every positive combination sum c_a r_a r_a^T of the A_3 root dyadics a3SchedulerRoot has no negative direction (its quadratic form is sum c_a (r_a.v)^2) and, if it is an involution, it is the identity (eq_one_of_involution_nonneg) - so it cannot replace the Krein involution; the Krein form <u, Ju> is positive on the +1 eigenspace and negative on the -1 eigenspace (indefinite when both are nonzero), and a positive Krein form forces J = 1. thm:supp-determining-kernel.title: Terminating determining-field and accepted-kernel compiler

lem:supp-executed-proposal-floor.title: A finite execution certificate for the proposal floor
lem:supp-executed-proposal-floor.note: Proved on an abstract probability space (MeasureTheory.Measure with IsProbabilityMeasure), bins 0..J-1 (the paper's 1..J shifted). The launch race is modelled by the decreasing no-earlier-launch events N l (N 0 = univ) and the predictor-marked first-launch events P l, a subset of N l \ N (l+1) (so they are automatically pairwise disjoint); the conditional probabilities 'given no earlier launch' are rendered in product form mu(N l \ N(l+1)) = a_l mu(N l), mu(P l) = f_l mu(N l), and the conditional execution floor as mu(G cap P l) >= q_* mu(P l). Under f_l >= rho_* a_l, -log S_J >= A_* > 0, 0 < rho_* <= 1, q_* > 0, executed_proposal_floor gives mu(G) >= q_* rho_* (1 - e^{-A_*}) (boxed eq:supp-executed-proposal-floor). The proof derives mu(N l) = S_l by induction, sums the disjoint events G cap P l (measure_biUnion_finset), and applies the arithmetic certificate proposal_floor_arith (telescoping survivalProduct_telescope: sum S_l a_l = 1 - S_J, then S_J <= e^{-A_*} via exp_log). Disclosed: the hypotheses A_* > 0 and rho_* <= 1 are carried but not needed (the bound holds without them); the events are assumed measurable.
